# `adc_ad7476` register map

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_regmap.py from regmap/adc_ad7476.yaml. Do not edit. -->

Sampling front end for the Digilent PmodAD1 (two Analog Devices AD7476A 12-bit SAR ADCs sharing SCLK and CS, each with its own serial data line). Both channels are therefore sampled simultaneously; there is no channel mux. Samples land in a small FIFO so the host can burst-read without racing the converter, and LAST keeps the most recent pair readable non-destructively for the OLED and for slow polling.

7 registers, 28 bytes.

| Offset | Name | Access | Reset | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ------ | ----- | ----------- |
| `0x00` | `CTRL` | rw | `0x00000000` | Run control. TRIG and FIFO_RESET are write-1-to-act and clear themselves. |
| `0x04` | `CFG` | rw | `0x00000004` | Serial-interface timing. |
| `0x08` | `RATE_DIV` | rw | `0x000003E7` | Continuous-mode sample period in aclk cycles minus one. f_sample = f_aclk / (RATE_DIV+1). Default 999 gives 100 kSPS from a 100 MHz aclk. A period shorter than one conversion is clamped by the engine, which reports OVERRUN. |
| `0x0C` | `STATUS` | ro | `0x00000000` | Live engine state. |
| `0x10` | `DATA` | ro | `0x00000000` | Destructive FIFO read. Reading pops one entry. VALID is 0 when the FIFO was empty, in which case the sample fields are meaningless. |
| `0x14` | `LAST` | ro | `0x00000000` | Most recent sample pair, non-destructive. Safe for display refresh and slow polling. |
| `0x18` | `SAMPLE_COUNT` | ro | `0x00000000` | Free-running count of completed conversions since reset. Wraps at 2**32. |

## `CTRL` (`0x00`, rw)

Run control. TRIG and FIFO_RESET are write-1-to-act and clear themselves.

| Bits | Field | Description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| `4` | `EXT_TRIG_EN` | Also start a conversion on a rising edge of the external trigger input. |
| `3` | `FIFO_RESET` | Self-clearing: flush the sample FIFO and clear OVERRUN. |
| `2` | `TRIG` | Self-clearing: start one conversion (single-shot mode). |
| `1` | `CONTINUOUS` | Free-run at the RATE_DIV period rather than one conversion per trigger. |
| `0` | `ENABLE` | Enable the acquisition engine. |

## `CFG` (`0x04`, rw)

Serial-interface timing.

| Bits | Field | Description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| `15:8` | `CS_HOLD` | Extra aclk cycles of CS high between conversions (quiet time |
| `7:0` | `CLK_DIV` | SCLK half-period in aclk cycles minus one. SCLK = f_aclk / (2*(CLK_DIV+1)). The AD7476A is rated to 20 MHz SCLK; the default of 4 gives 10 MHz from a 100 MHz aclk. |

## `STATUS` (`0x0C`, ro)

Live engine state.

| Bits | Field | Description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| `23:16` | `LEVEL` | Number of samples currently in the FIFO. |
| `3` | `OVERRUN` | A sample was dropped because the FIFO was full. Cleared by CTRL.FIFO_RESET. |
| `2` | `FIFO_FULL` | FIFO cannot accept another sample. |
| `1` | `FIFO_EMPTY` | No samples available. |
| `0` | `BUSY` | A conversion is in progress. |

## `DATA` (`0x10`, ro)

Destructive FIFO read. Reading pops one entry. VALID is 0 when the FIFO was empty, in which case the sample fields are meaningless.

| Bits | Field | Description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| `31` | `VALID` | The popped entry was real. |
| `27:16` | `CH1` | Channel 1 conversion result |
| `11:0` | `CH0` | Channel 0 conversion result |

## `LAST` (`0x14`, ro)

Most recent sample pair, non-destructive. Safe for display refresh and slow polling.

| Bits | Field | Description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| `27:16` | `CH1` | Channel 1 |
| `11:0` | `CH0` | Channel 0 |
